1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. who appears on behalf of the State
Respondents.

2.  This petition has been filed with the following main prayers:-
"[I] Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari to quash the impugned first information report dated 05.08.2019 lodged by the opposite party no. 4 in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 0549/2019, Under Section-419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. and Section- 4/10 of U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998 at Karan Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153025205/
1 Police Station-Aashiyana, District-Lucknow, so far as it relates to present petitioner,
as contained in Annexure No.1 to the writ petition.

sentences.text:
[II] Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus thereby commanding and directing the opposite parties not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the impugned first information report dated 05.08.2019 lodged by the opposite party no.
4 in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 0549/2019, Under Section-419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C.
and Section- 4/10 of U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998 at Police Station-Aashiyana, District-Lucknow, as contained in Annexure No.1 to the writ petition."
3.

entities.text: U.P. Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1998
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is completely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the impugned F.I.R..
The allegations against the petitioner is that the co-accused, namely, Sahil Raj was caught during invigilation in the competitive examination impersonating the petitioner.
4. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that despite lapse of four years from the date of filing of the Impugned F.I.R. no evidence has been found against the petitioner.
Because of inordinate delay in filing of police report, the impugned F.I.R. is liable to be quashed.
5. Learned A.G.A. for the State Respondents has strongly opposed the prayer as made in this petition.
He also states that the main accused, namely, Sahil Raj/Imposter has been chargesheeted.
Charge sheet could not be filed against the petitioner perhaps because he is absconding.

6. This Court has perused the F.I.R. and finds no good ground to show interference in the impugned F.I.R.
7.
The writ petition is disposed of with liberty to approach the Trial Court.
Order Date :- 21.7.2023
